eps.ov: After finishing the greatest battle in Exgate Online history, the player gets incarnated as his character.
Lufas journeys to Svel and learns about what happened to the world in her 200 year absence.
Aries attacks Svel, fighting Megrez and Levia.

eps.t: They Were Pulling Strings Behind the Scenes!
eps.ov: After beating sense into Aries, Lufas punishes the devilfolk that manipulated him and catches up with Megrez.
Lufas creates an RV golem and enjoys a hot spring with Dina. Then they brave Lufas' grave.
Lufas recovers Libra, leaving Jean's party believing they conquered the Grave of the Black-Winged King.
Lufas takes a pit-stop at the new home of her people and memories resurface. Libra & Aries each uncover a foe.
Tensions in Gjallarhorn are verging on civil war as Lufas debates what to do. Libra grows suspicious of Dina.
Libra captures Jupiter, Lufas stops Aigokeros, and Dina calms the populace. Afterward, Merak get a pep-talk.
The truth about Dina comes to light and she comes to blows with Lufas. Is she really telling the truth though?

eps.t: A Wild Lufas Maphaal And a Wild Devil King Have Appeared at the Same Time!!!
eps.ov: The true Hero is summoned to defeat the Devil King! Yet his journey starts with encountering both Last Bosses!

eps.t: There Was Something Incredible in My Homeland!
eps.ov: At her homeland Lufas uncovers the reason for Parthenos' actions and hints to the real Lufas' true goals.
